content_sections.heading: About the Recruiting Company
content_sections.text: Cement Corporation of India Ltd. is a Central Govt. Public Sector Undertaking engaged in manufacturing and marketing of cement. Its registered office is at Core-V, Scope Complex, 7-Lodhi Road, New Delhi-110003. The notice says it proposes to engage qualified and experienced professionals on Fixed Term contract basis.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted in the prescribed form, in hard copy by post. No other mode is accepted, and applications in other formats will be rejected. The form can be downloaded in Word/PDF format from www.cciltd.in , career section. If possible, candidates may type the form and take a print for sending. Download the prescribed application form from the career section of www.cciltd.in . Complete the form in all respects and attach self attested copies of the certificates listed under Enclosures. Attach a Demand Draft of Rs. 100/- if you belong to UR/OBC/EWS. Write "Application for the post of ______" on the cover. Send it by ordinary post to: HOD (HR), Cement Corporation of India Limited, Post Box No.: 3061, Lodhi Road Post Office, New Delhi-110003. The notice says applications received after the due date will not be considered, and CCI is not responsible for any postal delay or loss/non-delivery.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Qualification: Full time 2 years MBA/PG Degree/Diploma/MSW in HR / Personnel Management/ Labour Welfare/IR. Experience: 2 years minimum post-qualification experience in HR, Industrial Relations, Welfare, Labour Laws, administrative functions in a company of repute. Age: upper age 35 years. The cut-off date for age and experience is 28.11.2026. Nationality: only Indian nationals can apply. Computer knowledge is essential for all posts. Post qualification experience is counted from the date of passing the exam, that is, issuance of the degree or the marksheet. Other things being equal, eligible candidates with additional relevant professional qualification and added experience in the cement industry etc. will be given preference. SC/ST: 5 years. OBC (Non-creamy layer): 3 years. Both apply against reserved positions only. PwD: 5 years, over and above the relaxation for SC/ST/OBC. Candidates ordinarily domiciled in Jammu & Kashmir between 01.01.1980 and 31.12.1989: 5 years. Ex-servicemen / Commissioned Officers / ECOs / SSCOs with at least 5 years of Defence service, released on completion of assignment: relaxation as per rules. For posts against UR, SC/ST/OBC candidates may also apply, strictly meeting the UR eligibility criteria. The consolidated contractual fee is ₹40,000/- for posting in Units and also for posting in Corporate Office / Regional Office / Zonal Office. For Unit posting, accommodation is to be provided as per entitlement, subject to availability of quarters. For Corporate, Regional or Zonal Office posting, ₹10,000/- shall be provided for accommodation. After successful completion of 01 year, candidates will be eligible for an annual increment of 5%. Medical: IPD facility, for self only, as per CCI rules. Leave: 20 days per year, non-encashable, but can be accumulated if CCI extends the contract. Provident Fund: as per EPF Act. T.A.: governed by TA rules of the Corporation as applicable to E-1 level employees. Maternity leave: as per Government of India Rules. The appointment is purely on Fixed Term contract and not permanent; it gives no claim to regular employment. The initial tenure is one year, extendable for another 3 years based on performance, up to a maximum of 04 years. Either side can end the contract by giving one month's notice or contractual fee in lieu of notice. All appointments are subject to medical fitness as per company rules. The notice states the post, category-wise vacancies and eligibility above; candidates should check the official notification for any further detail on eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee is paid through a Demand Draft in favour of Cement Corporation of India Limited, payable at New Delhi, enclosed with the other documents. Applications without the Demand Draft will be summarily rejected. Fee once paid is not refunded under any circumstance.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self attested copies of the following are to be enclosed: Proof of age: Matriculation certificate having date of birth. Qualification: all certificates and marksheets from 10th, 12th, Graduation and above. Caste certificate for SC/ST/OBC candidates, in the prescribed format for Central Govt. EWS certificate as per DoPT guidelines. Experience certificate issued by the employer, with clear date of joining and relieving. Latest salary slip for Govt. and Public Sector Undertakings employees. Aadhaar Card and PAN Card. Certificate of CTC from the latest employer for private candidates; if it is not enclosed, only the salary slip will be considered to determine annual CTC. The OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) and EWS certificates must be issued not more than 01 year before the last date of submission of application. Candidates have to furnish the certificate number and date of issue for SC/ST/OBC/PwD/EWS/Ex-servicemen to avail benefits.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates shortlisted for the post will be called for interview based on the declaration made in the application form. If a large number of applications are received against one post, shortlisting is done on relevant experience, current CTC/monthly pay and higher qualification, based on documents enclosed with the application. Candidates called for interview are eligible for sleeper class train fare by the shortest route, limited to the journey between the correspondence address declared in the form and the interview venue. The distance travelled must be more than 50 kms to claim it. Only shortlisted candidates will be notified, and mere fulfilment of eligibility does not confer any right to be called.

faq.question: Q1. How many Officer (HR) posts are vacant at CCI?
faq.answer: There are 2 Officer (HR) posts, Post Code 01, with UR-01 and OBC-01, including backlog vacancies, on Fixed Term contract.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for CCI Officer?
faq.answer: The last date of receiving applications is 28.11.2026 (Saturday), 05:00 PM. Applications received after the due date will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for CCI Officer (HR)?
faq.answer: Full time 2 years MBA/PG Degree/Diploma/MSW in HR / Personnel Management/ Labour Welfare/IR, with 2 years post-qualification experience in HR, Industrial Relations, Welfare, Labour Laws, administrative functions in a company of repute.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for CCI Officer?
faq.answer: The upper age is 35 years as on the cut-off date of 28.11.2026. Relaxation is 5 years for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC (Non-creamy layer) against reserved positions, and 5 years more for PwD.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of CCI Officer (HR)?
faq.answer: The consolidated contractual fee is ₹40,000/-, with a 5% annual increment after successful completion of 01 year. Accommodation of ₹10,000/- is provided for Corporate, Regional or Zonal Office posting.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for CCI Officer?
faq.answer: UR/OBC/EWS candidates pay Rs. 100/- by Demand Draft in favour of Cement Corporation of India Limited, payable at New Delhi. SC/ST/PWD/Females are exempted.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for CCI Officer?
faq.answer: Download the prescribed form from www.cciltd.in, career section, and send it with self attested copies by ordinary post to HOD (HR), Post Box No.: 3061, Lodhi Road Post Office, New Delhi-110003. Write "Application for the post of ______" on the cover.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected for CCI Officer?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates are called for interview, and a Written Test / Group Discussion can be held before it if required. Medical examination and document verification follow.

faq.question: Q9. Is the CCI Officer job permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is a Fixed Term contract with an initial tenure of one year, extendable by another 3 years, up to a maximum of 04 years. It gives no claim to regular employment.

faq.question: Q10. Can government or PSU employees apply?
faq.answer: Yes. They may apply through proper channel or submit an NOC at the time of interview, or submit a proper relieving letter from the present employer in the event of selection.
